input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: ids-model-check (flagship 12): buildable item 'next another public set'

doc_friction.issue: The CLI's argument order is model then IDS. Giving it IDS then model worked for a .ids file but failed with 'no root element' for an .ids.xml sample, which cost a retry; the usage line does not say the order matters.
A sweep where 10/10 workflows passed still exits 5 because some workflows defer to PR CI; the last line 'DONE exit 5' reads like a failure until you scroll back up to the 'Not a clean sweep' notes.

goal: Deepen flagship ids-model-check: run the model-driven sweeps on another public IFC set
notes: Sets: IfcOpenShell@16f9a41 (294 .ifc/.ifczip) and buildingSMART/IFC4.3.x-sample-models@ef22440 (46). The four sweeps passed on both (1,734/1,734 offers on IfcOpenShell). Beyond the item, this checker ran against IfcTester 0.9.0 on 293 models x 65 public IDS: 126,781 results, 1,614 different; a new script, eval/corpus_crosscheck_group.py, classifies them (1,453 invalid-IDS refusals, 147 subclass with matching count, 12 untyped IsExternal, 2 on an invalid fixture). Found and fixed: classes outside the model's schema (IFCBEAMSTANDARDCASE in IFC4X3) were silently unchecked by both tools; 7 of 26 public specifications reaching IfcBeam passed. Now a reader note plus skippedSubclasses with 'outside'. Verification: node --test outside-schema.test.mjs 6/6; run_venture_tests.py ids-model-check ok (549 tests, 2 skipped); 0 of 19,045 pair verdicts changed; sweeps identical apart from timing; IfcTester agrees on the new sample (B-01 pass, 1 applicable); run_workflow_locally --for-changes 10/10 workflows passed (exit 5: cross-review and deploy jobs deferred to PR CI); check_posts ok; venture-preflight.mjs ids-model-check clean; PR CI green apart from changed-ventures, which was still running at record time.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a BIM tooling engineer: fetch two sets, run two checkers over 19k pairs, classify 1.6k differences, fix and test the reader, write it up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
